title: Building a Restock Planner
excerpt: How the restock feature in my Inventory CLI went from a plain low-stock list to a budgeted purchase plan.
content:
The restock command started as a simple low-stock report. It grew into something more useful: given a target quantity, it lists every product that is short, how many units to buy, and the total cost of the order.

Calculating money with Python's Decimal type kept the totals exact, and writing results atomically kept the data file safe.
